Visitor customizes details/summary disclosure elements

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorDetailsSummaryCustom struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorDetailsSummaryCustom) VisitSummary(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`[EXPANDABLE] %s`, text))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorDetailsSummaryCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<details><summary>Click to expand</summary><p>This content is initially hidden.</p><p>But can be revealed by the user.</p></details>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
